name: speak-reply
description: Read the first line and the "Next:" line of each Claude reply out loud with Piper (offline neural voice), in Dutch or English.

voice_en.title: English voice
voice_en.description: Piper voice for English lines: a voice name in ~/.local/share/piper-voices (like en_US-lessac-high) or the full path to an .onnx file.

voice_nl.title: Dutch voice
voice_nl.description: Piper voice for Dutch lines: a voice name in ~/.local/share/piper-voices (like nl_NL-pim-medium) or the full path to an .onnx file.
